$comment: Surfaces fixed in place while still unconverted, under the urgent-fix escape in AGENTS.md.
A debt ledger, not a permit. It obeys the rule every other baseline in this repository obeys:
the only edit is downward. A row leaves by the surface becoming an extension — never because
somebody decided the debt had aged out.
A surface already listed here may not take the escape a second time. One emergency is an
emergency; two is a plan, and a plan does not need an escape hatch.
Each row: the surface, the date, what was urgent, and which file carries the comment at the site.

urgent: A session pinned to the account that is the platform default ran under whichever
CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR the operator's shell exported into Wanigan. accounts.launchEnv
correctly contributes no variable for that account, and agentEnv spread that
nothing over an inherited environment, so the inherited value survived. The
session used another login's credentials, history and settings while the launch
record and the UI both named the account it was pinned to, and resuming one of
its conversations answered "No conversation found with session ID" and exited 1.
Reproduced by varying only the config directory on one conversation id.
src/main/sessions.ts.comment: src/main/sessions.ts, in agentEnv where the account environment is applied
note: The decision itself was moved to accounts.applyLaunchEnv, which is tested and is
not this surface. What is unconverted here is the single call that applies it.
Four other callers still spread launchEnv the old way and have the same defect:
They were left alone deliberately — this row buys one fix, not a licence.
